Do you happen to know what day it is?

Ahem, in case master didn't know…

And since master still remembers Lucy even though so much time has passed… 

That truly is what Lucy sincerely wished for!

Master will remember Lucy from now on, right?

Thank you again for being with Lucy, master.

Please take good care of us in the future!"

notes.title: Restriction on streaming has been lifted.
notes.notes:
Soon, the 3rd Anniversary of Lucy is approaching.

So we decided to release all restrictions on streaming of Lucy.

As a result, you are now free to upload the whole gameplay of your streaming on YouTube or Twitch.

If you previously uploaded the videos on 'private' setting, you may now switch it back to 'public'.

[b]However, this does not include No commentary videos, Ending only videos or extracting and uploading the OST music separately.[/b]

We would like to express our sincere appreciation to all streamers who have respected our streaming policy and have kept promises.

Thank you.

notes.title: Latin American Spanish version (Nuetral Spanish)
notes.notes:
Dear visual novel readers,

Due to the recent changes in STEAM language support, our Spanish version is now categorized as Latin American Spanish (Neutral Spanish).

This is to avoid any possible confusions and we want to provide accurate store information as possible.

If you have installed the Spanish version previously, please note that new patches will be available as Latin American Spanish setting from now on.

So in order to avoid any possible conflict errors, we recommend that you switch the language setting for Lucy to Latin American Spanish.

We do not know when we're going to support Castilian (European) Spanish, because we do not have any translators who can help us with Spanish expressions.

But when we do, we will keep you posted.

Thank you!

notes.title: Spanish version has been temporarily disabled. (Updated)
notes.notes:
Dear Spanish users!

We are aware of many accent mark and misspellings errors along with some major system problems.

Not only that, we have come to a conclusion that Spanish translation need to go through more proof-reading process in order to achieve better quality.

Therefore, we had no choice but to disable the Spanish version for now.

Our deepest apologies.

Right now, system problems have been solved, but proof-reading is still in progress. We are also willing to re-translate certain chapters if necessary.

Sadly, this is not something that can be done in just a few weeks. It may possibly take a few months.

But we promise you that we will bring you Spanish translation in best quality as possible.

Again, we apologize for the delay, and thank you for your patience.

Sincerely,

M-Vizlab

It has been our dream to share this story with people around the globe, but we never thought that we could actually release the game in Russian.

Therefore, we are very excited about this and we truly hope you enjoy the journey with Lucy.

Most Sincerely,

M-Vizlab

notes.title: STEAM Trading Card & v.1.03 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have a good news!

STEAM Trading Card is finally here!

Also, Lucy has been updated to version 1.03.


v.1.03 Notes

- STEAM Trading Card added

- More natural English translation has been applied in the beginning

- Fixed misplaced character dialogues

- Fixed minor bugs and spelling errors

- All contents reset feature added

- All contents unlock feature added



All contents unlock allows you to unlock every Achievements/CGs/Extras. This feature is designed for users who lost all of their in-game progress due to the reset bug.

You can use this feature by typing in a password at the hidden title screen, after getting 'Faster than Light' achievement. [spoiler]Hint: Lucy's commonly used interjection[/spoiler]

However, this feature is recommended to those who have finished playing the whole contents only.

If you have any questions, please send us an e-mail at mvizlab@gmail.com.

Thank you for playing Lucy!

notes.title: Regarding 'Let's Play' of Lucy (UPDATED)
notes.notes:

So here we are, posting it again with few changes.

1. From now on, playthrough has no time limit. Whether to play normal speed, or edit video to skip, it's totally up to you. However, please keep in mind that you're only allowed to upload until the end of 'Oct 19th', which would be more than 3 hours length in normal speed.

2. Please leave a link to our STEAM store page, IF you enjoyed playing our game. If not, it is not necessary. We respect your opinion :)

Please keep these two conditions.

Thank you!

notes.title: RESET BUG ISSUE (FIXED)
notes.notes:
We know that many people are still having trouble from Unlocks/Achievements Reset issues.

And we've found the reason why.

It was because of DRM package process and it is now fixed.

However, there is a possibility that the same thing can happen when you attempt to change the language settings.

So we recommend that you make a back up of Config.nkenv (this is the file that keeps record of unlocks and options settings) file from Lucy folder if possible.

We're sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Achievement Resets
notes.notes:
We've just fixed few bug issues:

1. Volume Mixer icon bug

2. Unable to run the game in certain systems

However, there is also a bad news.

In that process, we made a mistake and reset all the unlocks. T.T

That includes : Achievements/CG Gallery/Extra episodes.

We're very sorry about this.

Honestly, we didn't expect this to happen.

If you're very angry about this, we're willing to send 'omake' (unlocked save data) file.

Please contact mvizlab@gmail.com if you need one.

Again, we apologize for this inconvenience.

P.S - Please note that we won't send the save data file to you unless you played this game for more than 2.5 hours. Because it's almost impossible to finish the game without skip button, and knowing all the tricks.

notes.title: Regarding posting 'Let's play' YouTube Streaming
notes.notes:
You are free to post up 'Let's play' of Lucy, but in few conditions.

1. Playthrough time is allowed for maximum of 3 hours in regular speed. (No skipping) 

2. If you think you're about to hit the climax scene, please stop there. We do not want any spoilers for other users. 

3. Please leave a link to our STEAM store page, IF you enjoyed playing our game. If not, it is not necessary. We respect your opinion :)

Please keep these conditions above.

Thank you for loving Lucy!
